$meta.name: Rukka Folio design tokens
$meta.note: Single source of truth. tokens.css and tokens.dart are generated views of this file — hand-synced until M0 adds scripts/gen_tokens. Values marked PROPOSED need owner sign-off (see design-system.md §2).

bg.role: app background — paper, never pure white

text.role: body text — ink, never pure black

hairline.role: table rules, dividers — the ruled-column motif

primary.role: ink-indigo: headers, primary buttons, links. NEVER a value judgement

accent.role: bahi red: one accent per screen max; also the seal

credit.role: money in — NUMERALS ONLY, always with + and column position

debit.role: money out — NUMERALS ONLY, always with − and column position

pending.role: PROPOSED — awaiting-approval state (amber/mustard, distinct from accent and debit)

locked.role: PROPOSED — locked periods, disabled dates, read-only (warm grey)

primary.role: indigo lifted for contrast on ink

family.note: One family across scripts (brand §4.4): Mukta = Latin+Devanagari, Mukta Mahee = Gurmukhi; Noto Sans fallback only

numerals.rule: font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums on EVERY element containing an amount — global, non-negotiable (brand §4.4)

typography.scalingRule: All sizes are logical px at 1.0 scale; must survive OS font scale 200% (07 §18) — layouts size to content, never fixed heights on text containers; containers budget +40% for the longest scripts (brand §5)

space.note: 4pt grid; screen gutter 16; card padding 16; list row min-height 56

ruleLeft.note: 3px left rule on cards/callouts — never rounded on that side (brand §4.1)

elevation.rule: hairlines over shadows — this is a paper product

mark-unlock.note: sealed→open per brand §4.2; plays ONLY on real unlock; jump cut under prefers-reduced-motion

iconography.note: shape language = rules, columns, folds (brand §4.1); no filled blobs
